newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS END TRENDLESS SESSION A TOUCH LOWER.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS END TRENDLESS SESSION A TOUCH LOWER.

text.p: U.S. personal income data but closed a shade lower after an
earlier softening in lacklustre trade, dealers said.
U.S. personal income and spending both rose 0.6 percent in
August, in line with economists' forecasts.
Many dealers said trade was subdued on the Finnish market
since it was the last day of the month. "Most have already
wrapped up their monthly results," one dealer said.
